verdict.rationale: x402 documents per-transaction spend limits via the 'upto' authorize-and-settle scheme and batch-settlement's cryptographically signed voucher limits/escrow, and agentic accounts let an agent hold a funding source — but there is no documented mechanism to set a persistent per-agent spend cap/usage quota across sessions or to instantly revoke an agent's payment authority; a community commenter even suggests pairing x402 with a third-party 'budget SDK' for spending ceilings, implying it's not native. missing for 10: native per-agent spend-cap configuration, usage-limit dashboards, and an instant revocation/kill-switch mechanism for agent payment authority.
